Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu werden – und das macht jeder Mensch hier. Sie werden dazu befähigt, zu führen, zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam erzeugen.

Diese Position berichtet an: Immobilienmanager

Machen Sie Ihren nächsten Karriereschritt bei ABB mit einem Team, das die Transformation von Gesellschaft und Industrie zu einer produktiveren, nachhaltigeren Zukunft antreibt.

Bei ABB setzen wir uns für Vielfalt und Inklusion in allen Dimensionen ein. Gemeinsam schaffen wir ein Umfeld, in dem individuelle Unterschiede geschätzt und gefeiert werden.

Sie haben umfangreiche Erfahrung im Corporate Real Estate and Facility Management innerhalb der Schweiz? Sie möchten die Verantwortung für die Facility Management-Aktivitäten der ABB in der ganzen Schweiz übernehmen und ein großes FM-Transformationsprogramm leiten? Dann schließen Sie sich unserem Team in Baden als Lead Facility Management Schweiz an.

In dieser zentralen Führungsrolle übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Facility Management-Aktivitäten der ABB in der ganzen Schweiz, die ein bundesweites Portfolio von rund 240.000 qm Büro-, Produktions-, FuE- und Logistikflächen an mehreren Standorten beaufsichtigen. Sie überwachen die Lieferung integrierter FM-Dienste über externe Partner, treiben operative Exzellenz und Kostenoptimierung voran und spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung des zukünftigen FM-Betriebsmodells für ABB Schweiz.

• Verantwortung

- Lead Facility Management Service-Lieferung über das Schweizer Portfolio von ABB, die als primäre Schnittstelle mit dem integrierten FM-Anbieter und die Gewährleistung der vertraglichen Compliance, Governance, KPI-Erfolg und Service-Excellence.

- Antrieb für die Fertigstellung der nationalen FM-Transformation von ABB, einschließlich der Fertigstellung der FM-Ausschreibung, der Übergangsplanung und der erfolgreichen Mobilisierung des neuen FM-Partners an allen Schweizer Standorten.

- Optimieren Sie die operative Leistung, Compliance und Kosteneffizienz, um die Einhaltung der regulatorischen, HSE- und ABB-Standards zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig kontinuierliche Verbesserungen in der Servicequalität, Nachhaltigkeit und Benutzererfahrung zu erzielen.

- Unterstützung strategischer Immobilien- und Anlagenziele, Nutzung datengesteuerter Erkenntnisse, Zusammenarbeit der Stakeholder und Projektführung zur Verbesserung der Portfolioleistung und Bereitstellung von Anlageninvestitionen.

Ihr Hintergrund

- Bachelor oder Master in Facility Management, Real Estate, Engineering, Business Administration oder einem verwandten Bereich.

- Etwa 10 Jahre Erfahrung in Corporate Real Estate und/oder Corporate Facility Management innerhalb der Schweiz, vorzugsweise innerhalb einer großen Multi-Site-Organisation.

- Bewährte Erfahrung mit Outsourced FM Verträge, externe Dienstleister und integrierte FM Service Delivery Modelle.

- Erfahrung führende FM Transformation, Outsourcing, Mobilisierung oder Übergangsprojekte, mit starken Projektmanagement-Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe funktionsübergreifende Initiativen zu treiben.

- Ein starkes Verständnis des Betriebs Facility Management, Vertragsmanagement, Leistungsüberwachung, Budgetierung, Prognose und Kostenoptimierung.

- Ausgezeichnete Stakeholder-Management- und Kommunikationskompetenzen, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv auf allen Organisationsebenen zu beeinflussen und zusammenzuarbeiten; proaktive, kundenorientierte und lösungsorientierte Denkweise.

- Es ist eine fließende deutsche und englische Sprache erforderlich; die Erfahrung, die Initiativen zur digitalen Transformation im Facility Management vorantreibt, einschließlich KI, Smart Buildings, Predictive Maintenance, Workflow Automation und Advanced Analytics, ist ein starker Vorteil.

Warum uns begleiten?

Dies ist eine einzigartige Chance, die Zukunft des Facility Managements bei ABB Schweiz zu gestalten. Neben der Verwaltung eines bedeutenden Immobilienportfolios führen Sie den Übergang zu einem neuen integrierten FM-Liefermodell und schaffen die Grundlage für langfristige operative Exzellenz im ganzen Land.

Mehr über uns

Unsere Mission in Real Estate (RE) ist es, ABB-Unternehmen durch ein globales Immobilienmanagement, das den gesamten Lebenszyklus von der Standortauswahl, dem Management und der Wartung bis zur Beendigung des Betriebs abdeckt, zu ermöglichen, ihre besten Leistungen zu erbringen. Wir haben eine Leidenschaft für operative Exzellenz und bemühen uns, Wert für ABB-Unternehmen zu schaffen. Unsere Bemühungen wachsen aus dem Engagement heraus, gesunde und engagierte Arbeitsumgebungen bereitzustellen, Energieeffizienz und Nachhaltigkeit zu verbessern und die Raumeffizienz für alle unsere Gebäude in mehr als 100 Ländern der Welt zu optimieren.

Wir schätzen Menschen aus verschiedenen Herkunft.

Könnte das deine Geschichte sein?

Bewerben Sie sich heute oder besuchen Sie www.abb.com, um mehr über uns zu erfahren und über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren. #MyABBStory

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung (Dokumente in englischer Sprache werden geschätzt).

Der Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Gema de Vicente, Talent Partner bei ABB Switzerland Ltd. geleitet.

Eine sauberere, intelligentere Zukunft zu schaffen, erfordert alle Arten von Gedanken: Neugierige, Mutige und Kreative. Deshalb heißen wir Menschen aus allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen willkommen.

Bereit, einen Schlag zu machen?

Bewerben Sie sich heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus maigres et plus propres, et chaque personne ici fait cela. Vous, serez habilité à diriger, soutenu pour grandir, et fier de l'impact que nous créons ensemble.

Ce poste relève de : Gestionnaire immobilier

__

Prenez votre prochaine étape de carrière à ABB avec une équipe qui est en train d'activer la transformation de la société et de l'industrie pour atteindre un avenir plus productif et durable.

Chez ABB, nous nous engageons à stimuler la diversité et l'inclusion dans toutes les dimensions. Ensemble, nous créons un environnement où les différences individuelles sont appréciées et célébrées.

Vous avez une vaste expérience en gestion immobilière et de la gestion des installations en Suisse? Vous voulez prendre en charge les opérations de gestion des installations d'ABB dans toute la Suisse et diriger un programme de transformation FM majeur? Ensuite, rejoignez notre équipe à Baden comme responsable de la gestion des installations en Suisse.

Dans ce rôle de leader, vous serez responsable des opérations de gestion des installations d'ABB dans toute la Suisse, superviserez un portefeuille national d'environ 240 000 m2 d'espaces de bureau, de production, de R & D et de logistique sur plusieurs sites. Vous superviserez la prestation de services FM intégrés par l'intermédiaire de partenaires externes, stimulerez l'excellence opérationnelle et l'optimisation des coûts, et jouerez un rôle clé dans la formation du futur modèle opérationnel FM d'ABB Suisse.

Vos responsabilités

- Prestation de services de gestion de l'installation de pointe dans l'ensemble du portefeuille suisse d'ABB, agissant comme interface principale avec le fournisseur de FM intégré et assurant la conformité contractuelle, la gouvernance, la réalisation de l'ICK et l'excellence des services.

- Conduire l'achèvement de la transformation nationale de la FM d'ABB, y compris la finalisation de l'appel d'offres FM, la planification de la transition et la mobilisation réussie du nouveau partenaire FM dans tous les sites suisses.

- Optimiser la performance opérationnelle, la conformité et l'efficacité économique, en veillant au respect des normes réglementaires, HSE et ABB tout en améliorant continuellement la qualité du service, la durabilité et l'expérience des utilisateurs.

- Appuyer les objectifs stratégiques en matière d'immobilier et d'installations, en tirant parti des données recueillies, en collaborant avec les intervenants et en dirigeant des projets pour améliorer le rendement du portefeuille et réaliser des investissements dans les installations.

Vos antécédents

- Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en gestion d'installations, immobilier, génie, administration des affaires ou un domaine connexe.

- Environ 10 ans d'expérience en gestion immobilière et/ou en gestion d'entreprise en Suisse, de préférence au sein d'une grande organisation multi-site.

- Provenez de l'expérience en gérant les contrats de FM sous-traités, les fournisseurs de services externes et les modèles intégrés de prestation de services de FM.

- Expérience de projets de transformation, d'externalisation, de mobilisation ou de transition de la gestion de projet, avec de solides compétences en gestion de projet et la capacité de mener des initiatives interfonctionnelles complexes.

- Une bonne compréhension de la gestion opérationnelle des installations, de la gestion des contrats, du suivi des performances, de la budgétisation, des prévisions et de l'optimisation des coûts.

- Excellentes compétences en gestion des intervenants et en communication, avec la capacité d'influencer et de collaborer efficacement à tous les niveaux organisationnels; attitude proactive, axée sur le client et orientée vers la solution.

- La maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais est nécessaire; l'expérience qui conduit les initiatives de transformation numérique dans la gestion des installations, y compris l'IA, les bâtiments intelligents, la maintenance prédictive, l'automatisation des workflows et l'analyse avancée, est un avantage important.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre?

C'est une occasion unique de façonner l'avenir de Facility Management chez ABB Suisse. Au-delà de la gestion d'un important portefeuille immobilier, vous dirigerez la transition vers un nouveau modèle de livraison FM intégré et établirez les bases d'une excellence opérationnelle à long terme dans tout le pays.

Plus sur nous

Notre mission en immobilier (RE) est de permettre aux entreprises ABB de se comporter au mieux grâce à une gestion immobilière globale qui couvre le cycle de vie complet de bout en bout, de la sélection, de la gestion et de la maintenance du site à la terminaison du site. Nous sommes passionnés par l'excellence opérationnelle et faisons tout notre possible pour créer de la valeur pour les entreprises ABB.

Nous apprécions les gens de différents horizons.

Ça pourrait être votre histoire?

Postuler aujourd'hui ou visiter www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur nous et en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions dans le monde entier. #MyABBStory

Nous attendons avec impatience votre demande (les documents présentés en anglais sont appréciés).

Le processus de recrutement est dirigé par Gema de Vicente, Talent Partner chez ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous horizons et expériences.

Prêt à avoir un impact?

Faites votre demande aujourd'hui ou visitez https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions dans le monde entier.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Project Operations Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities:
As an Order Management Specialist, you serve as the primary point of contact for customers and business partners regarding UPS Systems within the Electrification/ Power Protection business area, based in Baden, Switzerland.

Reporting to the Head of Project management & Engineering, you play a key role in supporting the sales-& project management team by leveraging your customer service & project execution expertise to manage and respond to customer inquiries and project needs efficiently and professionally.

The work model for the role is: #hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Processes orders by coordinating with Sales, Project and other internal teams to ensure that customers receive accurate and timely delivery of products
  • Organize project material logistics with factory, suppliers and customers
  • Monitor order production status, delivery schedules, and proactively manage delays or escalations to maintain customer satisfaction
  • Handle invoicing and customer account setup in accordance with internal guidelines and project team input
  • Supports the sales/ project team in execution phase by resolving customer issues and ensuring effective and efficient customer and internal stakeholders communication


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Completed commercial apprenticeship; further education at higher vocational level (HF) is an advantage
  • Several years of professional experience in order processing or a similar role
  • Agile and proactive mindset with a proven ability to take ownership of customer issues
  • Solid knowledge and experience in customer service
  • Confident user of SAP
  • Experience in EU-Export Process is an advantage
  • Strong team player with a solution-oriented and independent working style, combined with excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Fluent in German and French; Italian is a plus and English is welcome


More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers,
low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment is led by Pedro Labian Sanchez, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

  • Fluent in Deutsch und Französisch; Italienisch ist ein Plus und Englisch ist willkommen

Gestionnaire des opérations de projet

En tant que spécialiste de la gestion des commandes, vous êtes le principal point de contact pour les clients et les partenaires commerciaux concernant UPS Systems dans le secteur d'activité Electrification/Protection de l'alimentation, basé à Baden, en Suisse.

ABB Smart Power fournit des solutions de distribution d'énergie pour les centres de données, les usines industrielles et manufacturières, les infrastructures essentielles et les bâtiments commerciaux. jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Maintenance Team Leader

__

At ABB, we value individual differences, both as individuals and as a team.

ABB Switzerland Ltd., CMC Low Voltage Products, with around 270 employees, is a leading developer, manufacturer, and international supplier of low-voltage protection devices and the CMS current monitoring system. A customer-focused mindset, short decision-making paths, and a high degree of personal responsibility are key to strengthening our market position.

To strengthen our motivated team in Schaffhausen, we are looking for an engaged Service Technician to join us as soon as possible. Do you enjoy solving technical problems and helping to ensure smooth operations in a stable, growing, and modern manufacturing environment?


We look forward to receiving your application.


Your role and responsibilities


• Troubleshoot and resolve issues on highly automated production equipment (mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic)

• Perform preventive maintenance and servicing of production equipment

• Collaborate closely with manufacturing teams, Production Engineering, and external service providers to ensure smooth production operations

• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the production environment, including Lean Management activities


• Qualifications for the role


• Completed vocational training as an Automation Technician, Mechatronics Technician, Mechanical Technician, Production Technician, Electrician, or in a comparable technical field

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in industrial automation, ideally within a manufacturing environment

• Experience troubleshooting and repairing complex production and assembly systems (mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic)

• NIV13 or NIV15 electrical installation certification is an advantage, or willingness to obtain it with ABB support

• Strong teamwork and communication skills, combined with a proactive and independent working style

• Basic knowledge of MS Office and SAP, as well as excellent German language skills (written and spoken); English language skills are an advantage

• Willingness to work in a three-shift operation, including on-call duty after the onboarding period


Benefits


• We offer our employees a range of attractive benefits, including:

• Attractive compensation package including bonus, 13th-month salary, and Employee Share Acquisition Program (ESAP)

• Training, development, and career growth opportunities

• Contributions toward gym memberships and medical services (IFA)

• REKA vouchers and discounts through Swibeco

• 27 to 30 days of annual leave, plus paid company holidays between Christmas and New Year


More about us


Our Schaffhausen site has been growing steadily for many years.

Our diverse production environment offers exciting and varied areas of responsibility, ranging from proven, long-established technologies to state-of-the-art system solutions. Our machine park is continuously expanding with new equipment that is aligned with industry benchmarks.

ABB Smart Buildings digitizes commercial, industrial, and residential buildings to deliver the highest levels of comfort, efficiency, safety, and security. Through safe, intelligent, and sustainable electrification solutions, services, and products, we are improving quality of life in the buildings of the future.


The recruitment process is managed by Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Questa posizione riporta a: Maintenance Team Leader

E' un'idea divertente.

In ABB, apprezziamo le differenze individuali, sia come individui che come team.

ABB Switzerland Ltd., CMC Low Voltage Products, con circa 270 dipendenti, è uno sviluppatore, produttore e fornitore internazionale leader di dispositivi di protezione a bassa tensione e il sistema di monitoraggio corrente CMS. Una mentalità orientata al cliente, brevi percorsi decisionali e un alto grado di responsabilità personale sono fondamentali per rafforzare la nostra posizione sul mercato.

Per rafforzare il nostro team motivato a Schaffhausen, stiamo cercando un Service TechNICan impegnato a unirsi a noi il prima possibile. Ti piace risolvere problemi tecnici e contribuire a garantire operazioni fluide in un ambiente di produzione stabile, in crescita e moderno?

Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra domanda.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità

• Risolvere e risolvere problemi sulle apparecchiature di produzione altamente automatizzate (meccaniche, elettriche e pneumatiche)

• Eseguire la manutenzione preventiva e la manutenzione delle attrezzature di produzione

• Collaborare strettamente con i team di produzione, l'ingegneria di produzione e i fornitori di servizi esterni per garantire operazioni di produzione fluide

• Contribuire a iniziative di miglioramento continuo nell'ambiente produttivo, comprese le attività di Lean Management

• Qualificazioni per il ruolo

• Formazione professionale completa come automazione TechNICan, Mechatronica TechNICan, Meccanica TechNICan, Produzione TechNICan, Elettrica, o in un campo tecnico comparabile

• Minimo 10 anni di esperienza nell'automazione industriale, idealmente all'interno di un ambiente di produzione

• Sperimenta la risoluzione dei problemi e ripara sistemi complessi di produzione e assemblaggio (meccanici, elettrici e pneumatici)

• La certificazione NIV13 o NIV15 è un vantaggio, o la volontà di ottenerlo con il supporto ABB

• Forte lavoro di squadra e capacità comunicative, combinato con uno stile di lavoro proattivo e indipendente

• Conoscenze di base dell'ufficio MS e del SAP, nonché eccellenti competenze linguistiche tedesche (scritte e parlate); competenze linguistiche inglesi sono un vantaggio

• Disponibilità a lavorare in un'operazione a tre turni, compreso il servizio di guardia dopo il periodo di bordo

Prestazioni

• Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti una gamma di vantaggi interessanti, tra cui:

• Pacchetto di compensazione attraente compreso bonus, 13 ° mese di stipendio, e Dipendente Share Acquisition Program (ESAP)

• opportunità di formazione, sviluppo e crescita della carriera

• Contributi per l'iscrizione in palestra e servizi medici (IFA)

• Buoni REKA e sconti tramite Swibeco

• 27-30 giorni di ferie annuali, più ferie aziendali retribuite tra Natale e Capodanno

Più su di noi

Il nostro sito di Schaffhausen è in costante crescita da molti anni.

Il nostro ambiente produttivo offre aree di responsabilità emozionanti e variegate, che vanno dalle tecnologie collaudate e consolidate alle soluzioni di sistema all'avanguardia. Il nostro parco macchine si sta espandendo continuamente con nuove attrezzature allineate ai benchmark del settore.

ABB Smart Buildings digitalizza edifici commerciali, industriali e residenziali per offrire i più alti livelli di comfort, efficienza, sicurezza e sicurezza. Attraverso soluzioni di elettrificazione, servizi e prodotti sicuri, intelligenti e sostenibili, stiamo migliorando la qualità della vita negli edifici del futuro.

Il processo di reclutamento è gestito dal Partner di Acquisizione di Tante Emma Aslani.

Diese Position berichtet an: Wartung Team Leader

Bei ABB schätzen wir individuelle Unterschiede, sowohl als Individuen als auch als Team.

ABB Switzerland Ltd., CMC Low Voltage Products, mit rund 270 Mitarbeitern, ist ein führender Entwickler, Hersteller und internationaler Anbieter von Niederspannungsschutzgeräten und dem aktuellen CMS-Monitoring-System. Kundenorientiertes Denken, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein hohes Maß an persönlicher Verantwortung sind der Schlüssel zur Stärkung unserer Marktposition.

Um unser motiviertes Team in Schaffhausen zu stärken, suchen wir einen engagierten Servicetechniker, der sich so schnell wie möglich mit uns verbindet. Sie lösen gerne technische Probleme und helfen Ihnen, einen reibungslosen Betrieb in einem stabilen, wachsenden und modernen Fertigungsumfeld zu gewährleisten?

• Problembehandlung und Lösung von Problemen mit hochautomatisierten Produktionsanlagen (mechanische, elektrische und pneumatische)

• Präventive Wartung und Wartung von Produktionsanlagen durchführen

• Eng mit Fertigungsteams, Produktionstechnik und externen Dienstleistern zusammenarbeiten, um einen reibungslosen Produktionsablauf zu gewährleisten

• Beitrag zu kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen im Produktionsumfeld, einschließlich Lean Management-Aktivitäten

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Automationstechniker, Mechatroniker, Mechaniker, Produktionstechniker, Elektriker oder in einem vergleichbaren technischen Bereich

• Mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung in der industriellen Automatisierung, idealerweise in einem Fertigungsumfeld

• Erleben Sie die Fehlersuche und Reparatur komplexer Produktions- und Montagesysteme (mechanische, elektrische und pneumatische)

• Die Zertifizierung der elektrischen Anlagen NIV13 oder NIV15 ist ein Vorteil oder die Bereitschaft, sie mit ABB-Unterstützung zu erhalten

• Grundkenntnisse in MS Office und SAP sowie hervorragende Deutschkenntnisse (geschrieben und gesprochen); Englischkenntnisse sind ein Vorteil

• Bereitschaft zur Arbeit in einem Dreischichtbetrieb, einschließlich Bereitschaftsdienst nach der Anbordzeit

Vorteile

• Attraktive Vergütungspakete mit Bonus, Gehalt für 13 Monate und Erwerbsprogramm für Employee Share (ESAP)

• Ausbildung, Entwicklung und Karrierechancen

• Beiträge zu Mitgliedschaften im Fitnessstudio und medizinischen Dienstleistungen (IFA)

• REKA Gutscheine und Rabatte über Swibeco

• 27 bis 30 Tage Jahresurlaub, plus bezahlte Firmenferien zwischen Weihnachten und Neujahr

Mehr über uns

Seit vielen Jahren wächst unser Standort in Schaffhausen stetig.

Unser vielfältiges Produktionsumfeld bietet spannende und vielfältige Verantwortungsbereiche, von bewährten, bewährten Technologien bis hin zu hochmodernen Systemlösungen. Unser Maschinenpark baut kontinuierlich mit neuen Anlagen aus, die auf Branchen-Benchmarks abgestimmt sind.

ABB Smart Buildings digitalisiert gewerbliche, industrielle und Wohngebäude für höchste Komfort-, Effizienz-, Sicherheits- und Sicherheitsstandards. Durch sichere, intelligente und nachhaltige Elektrifizierungslösungen, Dienstleistungen und Produkte verbessern wir die Lebensqualität in den Gebäuden der Zukunft.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this position, you will perform service activities in accordance with work instructions and ABB quality and safety guidelines. You will ensure excellent customer service on a daily basis by planning service assignments and executing them in line with customer requirements and expectations. Through your clear and professional communication, you will contribute to customer satisfaction and loyalty by providing transparent information regarding schedules, processes, and expectations.

Work model: Field-based

This role is part of the Electrification, Smart Power division in Baden. Your key stakeholders will include customers, field service colleagues, and the internal service coordination team.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Collaborate with customers on-site to identify optimization opportunities and resolve existing challenges

  • Perform service assignments, identify technical issues, and conduct on-site or remote analysis within the service categories and product areas for which you are certified

  • Prepare material lists for service assignments and ensure that all required materials, spare parts, and tools are available, complete, and in proper working condition

  • Provide training to field service colleagues and customers as required

Our team

You will become part of a collaborative and supportive team where you can continue to grow both professionally and personally.

Your qualifications

  • Completed vocational training as an Automation Technician, Electrician, Electrical Installer, Electrical Planner, or a comparable technical qualification

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in automation, electrical engineering, or a related technical field; experience with UPS systems (uninterruptible power supply) is an advantage

  • Solid knowledge of electromechanical systems, diagnostic tools, and service processes in an industrial environment

  • Strong customer focus, flexibility in adapting to changing requirements, and a solution-oriented and collaborative approach to teamwork

  • Fluent German and basic English skills for professional communication with customers

  • Willingness to travel, participate in an on-call rotation, and occasionally work weekends; primary service area: Midlands / Bern region

  • Valid driver's license for assignments within Switzerland

Benefits

• We offer our employees a range of attractive benefits, including:

  • Attractive compensation package including bonus, 13th-month salary, and Employee Share Acquisition Program (ESAP)

  • Training, development, and career growth opportunities

  • Company vehicle and attractive fleet discounts

  • Contributions toward gym memberships and medical services (IFA)

  • REKA vouchers and discounts through Swibeco

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing facilities, critical infrastructure, and commercial buildings. The division's technical teams work closely with industry partners to develop innovative solutions that support growth, the energy transition, and sustainability goals.

Its portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting solutions, and safety devices such as switches and relays. The Power Protection business supports the world's largest data center companies with advanced and energy-efficient UPS solutions. In addition, ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable and user-friendly platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO₂ emissions.

The recruitment process is managed by Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In ABB, aiutiamo le industrie a funzionare più snello e più pulito.E ogni persona qui fa che accada. You.ll essere autorizzato a guidare, sostenuto per crescere, e orgoglioso dell'impatto che creiamo insieme. Unisciti a noi e aiuta a gestire ciò che gestisce il mondo.

Questa posizione riporta a: Service Manager

E' un'idea divertente.

Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità

In questa posizione, svolgerai attività di servizio in conformità con le istruzioni di lavoro e le linee guida per la qualità e la sicurezza ABB. Garantirai un servizio clienti eccellente su base giornaliera pianificando le assegnazioni di servizi e eseguendole in linea con le esigenze e le aspettative dei clienti. Attraverso la tua comunicazione chiara e professionale, contribuirai alla soddisfazione e alla fedeltà dei clienti fornendo informazioni trasparenti su orari, processi e aspettative.

Modello di lavoro: basato sul campo

Questo ruolo fa parte della divisione Electrification, Smart Power a Baden. I vostri principali stakeholder includeranno clienti, colleghi di servizio sul campo e il team di coordinamento interno del servizio.

Sarete responsabili principalmente di:

- Collaborare con i clienti in loco per individuare le opportunità di ottimizzazione e risolvere le sfide esistenti

- Eseguire incarichi di servizio, identificare problemi tecnici, e condurre analisi in loco o remota all'interno delle categorie di servizio e aree di prodotto per cui si sono certificati

- Preparare liste materiali per le assegnazioni di servizio e garantire che tutti i materiali, pezzi di ricambio e gli attrezzi necessari sono disponibili, completi, e in condizioni di lavoro adeguate

- Fornire formazione a colleghi e clienti del servizio sul campo come richiesto

La nostra squadra

Diventerai parte di un team collaborativo e di supporto dove potrai continuare a crescere sia professionalmente che personalmente.

Le tue qualifiche

- Formazione professionale completa come automazione TechNICan, elettricista, installatore elettrico, pianificatore elettrico, o una qualifica tecnica comparabile

- Almeno 3 anni di esperienza professionale in automazione, ingegneria elettrica, o un campo tecnico correlato; esperienza con sistemi UPS (alimentazione non interrompibile) è un vantaggio

- Conoscenza solida di sistemi elettromeccanici, strumenti diagnostici e processi di servizio in un ambiente industriale

- Forte attenzione al cliente, flessibilità nell'adattarsi alle esigenze mutevoli e approccio al lavoro di squadra orientato alla soluzione e collaborativo

- Abilità fluenti in tedesco e inglese di base per la comunicazione professionale con i clienti

- Volontà di viaggiare, partecipazione ad una rotazione di servizio e occasionalmente fine settimana di lavoro; area di servizio primario: Midlands / regione di Berna

- Patente di guida valida per le assegnazioni in Svizzera

Prestazioni

• Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti una gamma di vantaggi interessanti, tra cui:

- Pacchetto di compensazione attraente compreso bonus, 13 ° mese di stipendio, e Dipendent Share Acquisition Program (ESAP)

- Possibilità di formazione, sviluppo e crescita professionale

- Auto aziendale e interessanti sconti flotta

- Contributi per i membri della palestra e i servizi medici (IFA)

- Voucher REKA e sconti tramite Swibeco

Più su di noi

ABB Smart Power fornisce soluzioni di distribuzione energetica per data center, impianti industriali e produttivi, infrastrutture critiche e edifici commerciali. I team tecnici della divisione lavorano a stretto contatto con i partner del settore per sviluppare soluzioni innovative che supportano la crescita, la transizione energetica e gli obiettivi di sostenibilità.

Il suo portafoglio comprende interruttori industriali, sistemi a bassa tensione, soluzioni per l'avviamento di motori e dispositivi di sicurezza come interruttori e relè. L'azienda Power Protection supporta le più grandi aziende di data center al mondo con soluzioni UPS avanzate ed efficienti sotto il profilo energetico. Inoltre, ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager fornisce una piattaforma di facile utilizzo e di scalabilità che aiuta le organizzazioni a risparmiare energia e ridurre le emissioni di CO2.

Il processo di reclutamento è gestito dal Partner di Acquisizione di Tante Emma Aslani.

Costruire un futuro più pulito e intelligente richiede ogni tipo di mente: il curioso, il coraggioso e il creativo. Ecco perché accogliamo persone provenienti da ogni provenienza ed esperienza.

Pronto a fare un impatto?

Applica oggi o visita https://www.abb.com per saperne di più sull'impatto delle nostre soluzioni in tutto il mondo.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu werden – und das macht jeder Mensch hier. Sie werden dazu befähigt, zu führen, zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam erzeugen.

Diese Position berichtet an: Service Manager

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortung

In dieser Position führen Sie Serviceaktivitäten nach Arbeitsanweisungen und ABB Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsrichtlinien durch. Sie gewährleisten einen exzellenten Kundenservice täglich durch die Planung von Serviceaufträgen und deren Ausführung entsprechend den Kundenanforderungen und -erwartungen. Durch Ihre klare und professionelle Kommunikation tragen Sie zur Kundenzufriedenheit und -treue bei, indem Sie transparente Informationen zu Terminen, Prozessen und Erwartungen bereitstellen.

Arbeitsmodell: Feldgestützt

Diese Rolle gehört zum Geschäftsbereich Elektrifizierung, Smart Power in Baden. Zu Ihren wichtigsten Stakeholdern gehören Kunden, Außendienstmitarbeiter und das interne Service-Koordinationsteam.

Sie werden vor allem verantwortlich sein für:

- Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden vor Ort, um Optimierungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und bestehende Herausforderungen zu lösen

- Führen Sie Service-Aufgaben, technische Probleme zu identifizieren und führen Sie vor Ort oder Remote-Analysen innerhalb der Service-Kategorien und Produktbereiche, für die Sie zertifiziert sind

- Bereiten Sie Materiallisten für die Service-Aufgaben vor und stellen Sie sicher, dass alle benötigten Materialien, Ersatzteile und Werkzeuge verfügbar sind, komplett und in einwandfreiem Arbeitszustand

- Schulung von Außendienstmitarbeitern und Kunden bei Bedarf

Unser Team

Sie werden Teil eines kollaborativen und unterstützenden Teams, in dem Sie sowohl professionell als auch persönlich weiter wachsen können.

Ihre Qualifikationen

- Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Automationstechniker, Elektriker, Elektroinstallations- und Elektroplaner oder vergleichbare technische Qualifikation

- Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Automatisierung, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich; Erfahrung mit USV-Systemen (ununterbrechbare Stromversorgung) ist ein Vorteil

- Solide Kenntnisse von elektromechanischen Systemen, Diagnosewerkzeugen und Serviceprozessen in einem industriellen Umfeld

- Starke Kundenorientierung, Flexibilität bei der Anpassung an sich verändernde Anforderungen und ein lösungsorientierter und kollaborativer Ansatz für Teamwork

- Fließende deutsche und grundlegende Englischkenntnisse für die professionelle Kommunikation mit Kunden

- Bereitschaft zu reisen, an einer Telefonumdrehung teilzunehmen, und gelegentlich am Wochenende; primärer Servicebereich: Midlands / Bern Region

- Gültiger Führerschein für Aufträge innerhalb der Schweiz

Vorteile

• Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitern eine Reihe von attraktiven Vorteilen, darunter:

- Attraktive Vergütungspakete mit Bonus, Gehalt für 13 Monate und Erwerbsprogramm für Employee Share (ESAP)

- Weiterbildung, Entwicklung und Karrierechancen

- Unternehmen Fahrzeug und attraktive Flotte Rabatte

- Beiträge zu den Mitgliedschaften im Fitnessstudio und medizinischen Dienstleistungen (IFA)

- REKA Gutscheine und Rabatte über Swibeco

Mehr über uns

ABB Smart Power bietet Energieverteilungslösungen für Rechenzentren, Industrie- und Fertigungsanlagen, kritische Infrastruktur und gewerbliche Gebäude. Die technischen Teams des Geschäftsbereichs arbeiten eng mit Industriepartnern zusammen, um innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die Wachstum, Energiewende und Nachhaltigkeitsziele unterstützen.

Das Portfolio umfasst industrielle Leistungsschalter, Niederspannungssysteme, Motorstartlösungen und Sicherheitseinrichtungen wie Schalter und Relais. Das Power Protection-Geschäft unterstützt die weltweit größten Rechenzentrumsunternehmen mit fortschrittlichen und energieeffizienten USV-Lösungen. Zudem bietet ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager eine skalierbare und benutzerfreundliche Plattform, die Unternehmen dabei unterstützt, Energie zu sparen und CO2-Emissionen zu reduzieren.

Der Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani geleitet.

Eine sauberere, intelligentere Zukunft zu schaffen, erfordert alle Arten von Gedanken: Neugierige, Mutige und Kreative. Deshalb heißen wir Menschen aus allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen willkommen.

Bereit, einen Schlag zu machen?

Bewerben Sie sich heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus maigres et plus propres, et chaque personne ici fait cela. Vous, serez habilité à diriger, soutenu pour grandir, et fier de l'impact que nous créons ensemble.

Ce poste relève de : Gestionnaire de services

__

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Dans cette position, vous effectuerez des activités de service conformément aux instructions de travail et aux directives de qualité et de sécurité ABB. Vous assurerez un excellent service client au quotidien en planifiant les missions de service et en les exécutant conformément aux exigences et aux attentes du client.

Modèle de travail : sur le terrain

Ce rôle fait partie de la division de l'électricité intelligente de Baden. Vos principaux intervenants seront les clients, les collègues de service sur le terrain et l'équipe de coordination des services internes.

Vous serez principalement responsable de :

- Collaborer avec les clients sur place pour identifier les possibilités d'optimisation et résoudre les défis existants

- Effectuer des missions de service, identifier les problèmes techniques et effectuer des analyses sur place ou à distance dans les catégories de services et les secteurs de produits pour lesquels vous êtes certifié

- Préparer des listes de matériaux pour les affectations de service et s'assurer que tous les matériaux, pièces de rechange et outils requis sont disponibles, complets et en bon état de fonctionnement

- Offrir une formation aux collègues et aux clients des services sur le terrain, au besoin

Notre équipe

Vous deviendrez membre d'une équipe collaborative et solidaire où vous pourrez continuer à vous développer tant sur le plan professionnel que personnel.

Vos qualifications

- Formation professionnelle terminée en tant que technicien d'automatisation, électricien, installateur électrique, planificateur électrique ou qualification technique comparable

- Au moins 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle en automatisation, en génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique connexe; l'expérience avec les systèmes UPS (alimentation électrique non interruptible) est un avantage

- Connaissance solide des systèmes électromécaniques, des outils de diagnostic et des processus de service dans un environnement industriel

- Une forte orientation client, une flexibilité dans l'adaptation aux besoins changeants et une approche collaborative et orientée vers la solution pour le travail d'équipe

- Compétences linguistiques allemandes et anglaises de base pour la communication professionnelle avec les clients

- Volonté de voyager, de participer à une rotation sur appel et de travailler occasionnellement les week-ends; zone de service primaire: Midlands / Berne

- Permis de conduire valide pour les affectations en Suisse

Avantages

• Nous offrons à nos employés une gamme de prestations attrayantes, notamment:

- Trousse de rémunération attrayante incluant la prime, le salaire de 13e mois et le Programme d'achat d'actions d'employé (PAES)

- Possibilités de formation, de perfectionnement et d'avancement professionnel

- Voitures d'entreprise et réductions attractives pour le parc automobile

- Contributions pour les membres de la salle de gymnastique et les services médicaux (IFA)

- Les bons et les remises REKA via Swibeco

Plus sur nous

ABB Smart Power fournit des solutions de distribution d'énergie pour les data centers, les installations industrielles et de fabrication, les infrastructures critiques et les bâtiments commerciaux. Les équipes techniques de la division travaillent en étroite collaboration avec les partenaires industriels pour développer des solutions innovantes qui soutiennent la croissance, la transition énergétique et les objectifs de durabilité.

Son portefeuille comprend des disjoncteurs industriels, des systèmes à faible consommation d'énergie, des solutions de démarrage de moteurs et des dispositifs de sécurité tels que des commutateurs et des relais. L'entreprise Power Protection soutient les plus grandes entreprises de centres de données au monde avec des solutions UPS avancées et écoénergétiques.

Le processus de recrutement est géré par la Talent Acquisition Partner Emma Aslani.

Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous horizons et expériences.

Prêt à avoir un impact?

Faites votre demande aujourd'hui ou visitez https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions dans le monde entier.

jobs.title: Quality Specialist (f/m/d) 80-100%
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Quality Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will support the implementation of the local quality strategy, driving a strong quality culture, continuous improvement, and sustainable problem-solving. As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will ensure that all purchased materials and services meet ABB standards by qualifying suppliers, monitoring performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve world-class results.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification, Smart Buildings / Supplier Business Excellence & Development in Schaffhausen.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Supplier Qualification & Audits: Qualify and approve new suppliers and conduct regular process, system, and product audits.

  • Quality • Requirements & FAI: Define and communicate quality requirements and lead First Article Inspections and qualification processes.

  • Performance Monitoring & Improvement: Track supplier performance using KPIs (e.g., PPM, OTD) and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Non-Conformance Management: Investigate quality issues, perform root cause analysis, and ensure effective corrective actions (8D/CAPA).



• Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field) or equivalent professional experience

  • Good knowledge of English and German (spoken and written); additional languages are a plus

  • Experience in supplier quality management and supplier audits (ISO 9001, VDA 6.3, IATF 16949 or similar)

  • Knowledge of APQP/PPAP and First Article Inspection (FAI)

  • Strong problem-solving skills using root cause analysis methods (8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa)

  • Understanding of statistical quality methods (SPC, MSA, Gauge R&R)

  • Knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T, and material/component specifications



Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)

  • REKA credit

  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

  • Parental leave

  • Fitness allowance

  • Eco bonus



More about us
ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications.

The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

The recruitment process is led by talent partner, Ece Özen.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Sales Support Manager

__

To strengthen our engineering team, we are looking for a dedicated, experienced Project Engineer. In this role, you take responsibility as a technical authority for electrical engineering projects with low to medium complexity – particularly for medium-voltage, low-voltage and standby power systems in the service business (retrofit). You implement the requirements of concepts within the specified time and budget framework and ensure that all specifications, quality standards, safety requirements and standards are consistently met.


Work Model: #hybrid
Business Line: Service (Division Electrification)

Your responsibilities

  • Product configuration, creation of electrical schematics using EPLAN and preparation of simple mechanical drawings using AutoCAD

  • Creation of selectivity calculations

  • Execution of type testing (design verifications) for non-standard configurations based on checklists and applicable standards

  • Technical support during tests and commissioning and support of project management in technical reviews, customer meetings and implementation of change and variation requests

  • Development of effort estimates and feasibility recommendations for the quotation team

  • Preparation of system documentation, as-built documents and acceptance records

• Qualifications for the Role

  • Completed apprenticeship as an electrician or automation technician plus further training as a technician HF/FH or comparable qualification

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in project engineering, ideally in energy technology. Experience in mechanical engineering is an advantage.

  • Very good CAD skills in EPLAN Electric P8; AutoCAD skills are an advantage

  • Technical understanding of the engineering of power supply systems (MV/LV/emergency supply power), ideally with experience with low-voltage switchgear

  • Strong focus on safe working practices and commitment to compliance with all relevant safety guidelines

  • Very high self-motivation as well as independent, solution-oriented and responsible working methods

  • Team player with a cooperative approach and good communication skills; you are fluent in German and English – French language skills are an advantage

What We Offer

  • Attractive and performance-based compensation

  • Flexible working models (hybrid)

  • Comprehensive further training and development opportunities

  • Modern working environment and international collaboration

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities
In this role, you will play a key role in the installation, maintenance, and repair of UPS systems and battery installations. You will diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently, ensuring reliable and cost-effective solutions for our customers. Working in accordance with ABB policies, procedures, and safety standards, you will contribute to the continuous improvement of product quality and reliability. Leveraging your technical expertise and customer-focused approach, you will build strong relationships with customers and support the identification of new business opportunities. You will operate within ABB's established processes and quality standards, helping to deliver excellent service and customer satisfaction.


The work model for the role is: onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification, Smart Power Business in Baden, Kanton Aargau.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Perform and coordinate repair and maintenance activities on UPS systems and battery installations, including fault diagnosis, testing, and inspections.

  • Manage and maintain loan equipment and UPS modules.

  • Ensure the proper maintenance and availability of tools, equipment, and testing facilities.

  • Assist with inventory and warehouse management, including the procurement of spare parts and consumable materials.

​

• Qualifications for the role

  • Successfully completed vocational training in Electrical Engineering (Electrician, Electrical Installer, Electronics Technician, or equivalent).

  • Proven experience working with UPS systems, battery installations, and power electronics.

  • Fluent German language skills; English and Italian proficiency is considered a plus.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Reliable, proactive, and customer-focused, with a strong sense of responsibility and the ability to work independently.

​

Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan (ESAP)

  • REKA credits

  • Exclusive employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

  • Parental leave

  • Contribution towards fitness and health programs

  • Eco Bonus (sustainability incentive)

More about us
ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.


This recruitment process is being managed by Talent Partner Ece Özen.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.de:
At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, was die Welt beherrscht.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Service Manager

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten
In dieser Rolle spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Installation, Wartung und Reparatur von USV-Systemen und Batterieinstallationen. Sie diagnostizieren und lösen technische Probleme effizient und gewährleisten zuverlässige und kostengünstige Lösungen für unsere Kunden. In Übereinstimmung mit ABB Richtlinien, Verfahren und Sicherheitsstandards tragen Sie zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Produktqualität und -zuverlässigkeit bei. Durch die Nutzung Ihrer technischen Expertise und Ihres kundenorientierten Ansatzes bauen Sie starke Beziehungen zu Kunden auf und unterstützen die Identifizierung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten. Sie werden innerhalb der etablierten Prozesse und Qualitätsstandards von ABB arbeiten und dazu beitragen, exzellenten Service und Kundenzufriedenheit zu liefern.


Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: onsite

Diese Rolle trägt zum Elektrifizierung, Smart Power Business in Baden, Kanton Aargau bei.

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Durchführen und Koordinieren von Reparatur- und Wartungsaktivitäten an USV-Systemen und Batterieinstallationen, einschließlich Fehlerdiagnose, Tests und Inspektionen.

  • Verwalten und Instandhalten von Leihgeräten und USV-Modulen.

  • Gewährleisten Sie die ordnungsgemäße Wartung und Verfügbarkeit von Werkzeugen, Geräten und Testeinrichtungen.

  • Unterstützung beim Lager- und Lagermanagement, einschließlich der Beschaffung von Ersatzteilen und Verbrauchsmaterialien.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung in Elektrotechnik (Elektriker, Elektroinstallateur, Elektroniktechniker oder gleichwertig).

  • Bewährte Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit USV-Systemen, Batterieinstallationen und Leistungselektronik.

  • Fluent Deutschkenntnisse; Englisch- und Italienischkenntnisse gelten als Plus.

  • Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Kollaborationsfähigkeiten.

  • Zuverlässig, proaktiv und kundenorientiert, mit einem starken Verantwortungsbewusstsein und der Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten.

Benefits

Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitern auch die folgenden Vorteile an:

  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan (ESAP)

  • REKA Credits

    • < Elternurlaub

  • Beitrag zu Fitness- und Gesundheitsprogrammen

    • Eco Bonus (Nachhaltigkeitsanreiz)

Mehr über uns
ABB Smart Power bietet Energieverteilungslösungen für Rechenzentren, Industrie- und Produktionsanlagen, kritische Infrastrukturen und Geschäftsgebäude. Die technischen Teams der Division arbeiten eng mit Industriepartnern zusammen und liefern fortschrittliche Lösungen, die schnelles Wachstum, Energiewende und Nachhaltigkeitsziele unterstützen. Das Portfolio der Division umfasst industrielle Leistungsschalter, Niederspannungssysteme, Motorstartanwendungen und Sicherheitsgeräte wie Schalter und Relais. Seine Power Protection-Einheit unterstützt die weltweit größten Rechenzentrumsunternehmen mit fortschrittlichen energieeffizienten USV-Lösungen. Der ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager der Division bietet eine skalierbare, benutzerfreundliche Plattform, mit der Unternehmen Energie sparen und CO2-Emissionen reduzieren können.


Dieser Rekrutierungsprozess wird von Talent Partner Ece Özen geleitet.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Ready to make a impact?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Rejoignez-nous et aidez-nous à exécuter ce qui tourne le monde.

Cette position se rapporte à:

Service Manager

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités
Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'installation, la maintenance et la réparation des systèmes UPS et des installations de batteries. Vous pourrez diagnostiquer et résoudre efficacement les problèmes techniques, en assurant des solutions fiables et rentables pour nos clients. En travaillant conformément aux politiques, procédures et normes de sécurité ABB, vous contribuerez à l'amélioration continue de la qualité et de la fiabilité des produits. En tirant parti de votre expertise technique et de votre approche axée sur le client, vous établirez de solides relations avec les clients et favoriserez l'identification de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires. Vous fonctionnerez dans le cadre des processus et des normes de qualité établis par ABB, ce qui vous aidera à offrir un excellent service et la satisfaction de la clientèle.


Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : onsite

Ce rôle contribue à la Électrification, Smart Power Entreprise dans Baden, Kanton Aargau.

Vous serez principalement responsable :

  • Effectuer et coordonner les activités de réparation et d'entretien des systèmes d'UPS et des installations de batteries, y compris le diagnostic de défaillance, les essais et les inspections.

  • Gérer et entretenir les modules d'UPS et d'équipement de prêt.

  • Assurer la bonne maintenance et la disponibilité des outils, de l'équipement et des installations d'essai.

  • Aider à la gestion des stocks et des entrepôts, y compris l'achat de pièces de rechange et de matériel consomptible.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Formation professionnelle réussie en génie électrique (électricien, installateur électrique, technicien en électronique ou équivalent).

  • Expérience éprouvée de travail avec les systèmes d'UPS, les installations de batteries et l'électronique de puissance.

  • Les compétences linguistiques en allemand; la compétence en anglais et en italien sont considérées comme un atout.

  • Profitant des applications Microsoft Office.

  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en collaboration.

  • Reliable, proactif et axé sur le client, avec un fort sens des responsabilités et la capacité de travailler de façon autonome.

Congé parental

  • Contribution à des programmes de conditionnement physique et de santé

  • Eco Bonus (incitatif de durabilité)

    • En savoir plus sur nous
    ABB Smart Power fournit des solutions de distribution d'énergie pour les centres de données, les usines industrielles et manufacturières, les infrastructures essentielles et les bâtiments commerciaux. Les équipes techniques de la Division travaillent en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires de l'industrie, fournissant des solutions avancées qui soutiennent la croissance rapide, la transition énergétique et les objectifs de durabilité. Le portefeuille de la Division comprend des disjoncteurs industriels, des systèmes à basse tension, des applications de démarrage de moteurs et des dispositifs de sécurité comme les commutateurs et les relais. Son unité de protection de l'énergie prend en charge les plus grandes entreprises de centres de données du monde avec des solutions UPS à haut rendement énergétique. La division ABB CapacityTM Energy Manager fournit une plateforme évolutive et facile à utiliser qui aide les organisations à économiser de l'énergie et à réduire les émissions de CO2.


    Ce processus de recrutement est géré par Talent Partner Ece Özen.

    Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

    Prêt à faire un impact?

    Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.title: Real Estate Portfolio Strategy Specialist (80%-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Real Estate Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a Real Estate Portfolio Strategy Specialist, you will play a key role in shaping and executing ABB Switzerland’s real estate portfolio strategy, with a strong focus on investment, optimization, and divestment projects for ABB‑owned and leased sites.

You will manage complex and often confidential initiatives, coordinating closely with internal stakeholders (Business, Legal, Controlling, Accounting, Tax, Public Affairs) as well as external consultants, authorities, and transaction partners. Your ability to navigate financial, legal, and operational topics in parallel, while maintaining governance and timelines, will be critical to your success.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Lead the development and execution of ABB's real estate portfolio and workplace strategies, ensuring alignment with business priorities, growth plans, and workplace transformation objectives while driving portfolio efficiency, occupancy optimization, cost effectiveness, and long-term value creation.

  • Manage complex real estate transactions and portfolio initiatives, including investments, divestments, consolidations, restructurings, lease events, and workplace transformation projects across owned and leased facilities, ensuring compliance with governance processes, financial targets, approval requirements, and risk management standards.

  • Drive portfolio performance and decision-making through robust financial and operational analysis, including business case development, occupancy cost assessments, ROI evaluations, scenario modeling, utilization reviews, vacancy analysis, and portfolio recommendations to support local and global senior management.

  • Act as a senior business partner and project leader, collaborating with business, finance, legal, HR, procurement, landlords, developers, authorities, and external advisors to forecast future space demand, oversee due diligence and lease negotiations, and deliver real estate solutions that enhance employee experience, sustainability performance, operational effectiveness, and financial outcomes.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in corporate real estate, portfolio management, development, transactions, or a related field, with solid knowledge of the Swiss real estate and construction market.

  • Bachelor’s degree in real estate, Business Administration, Finance, or comparable discipline.

  • Strong financial acumen, including the ability to analyze and interpret financial statements, evaluate investment and divestment business cases, assess risks and returns, and support fact‑based decision‑making at management level.

  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and service‑oriented mindset, with the ability to work independently in a dynamic and demanding environment.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with confidence interacting at senior management level.

  • Strong organizational and project management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Fluency in German and English is essential.

More about us

Our mission in Real Estate (RE) is to enable ABB businesses to perform at their best through a global real estate management that covers the full end-to-end lifecycle from site selection, management and maintenance to site termination. We have a passion for operational excellence and make every effort to create value for ABB businesses. Our efforts grow out of a commitment to provide healthy and engaging work environments, improve energy efficiency and sustainability and optimize space efficiency for all our buildings in more than 100 countries all over the world. We value people from different backgrounds.

Could this be your story?

Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. #MyABBStory

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated).

The recruiting process is led by Gema de Vicente, Talent Partner at ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Sales Support Specialist w/m/d (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Support Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will support ABB Switzerland’s local sales organization as well as our customers throughout the entire quotation process in the field of drive technology. You will act as the central technical point of contact within your area of responsibility and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders on a daily basis.


• Your responsibilities include optimally sizing products for customers to best meet their requirements and applicable standards. In addition, you will calculate costs and prepare quotations with the relevant technical information. You will apply your technical expertise in a targeted manner and make a significant contribution to the successful preparation of proposals.


Work model: Hybrid


This position supports the local sales unit (Motion) in Baden, Canton Aargau.


Your main responsibilities

  • Technical consulting & solution development: You support sales and customers in selecting technically optimal and economically viable solutions for drive and automation systems.
  • End-to-end quotation management: You prepare and calculate technical and commercial quotations and support them through to successful completion.
  • Analysis & optimization: You analyze customer needs, market and competitor information, as well as lost opportunities, and derive targeted improvement measures.
  • Collaboration & quality assurance: You work closely with sales, business units, and other stakeholders and ensure compliance with quality, compliance, and HSE standards.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed technical education (e.g., automation technician, electronics technician, automation specialist, or similar)
  • Several years of professional experience (min. 5 years) in sales support, sales, or project environments
  • Very good German skills and good English skills, both written and spoken
  • Strong customer orientation and excellent communication skills
  • Analytical mindset and understanding of markets and processes
  • Initiative, structured way of working, and assertiveness
  • Advantageous: French language skills and further education at HF level (e.g., certified technician HF)

Benefits

• We offer, among others:

  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credit
  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Fitness allowance
  • Eco bonus

More about us

ABB Motion provides industrial customers with cutting-edge technologies, products, solutions, and related services to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and ensure precise control of processes. The portfolio includes motors, generators, and drives for a wide range of applications across all industries.


The recruitment process is managed by Ece Özen, Talent Partner.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Service Team Leader (f/m/d) 80-100%
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager

__

Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will lead a regional service team with diverse expertise in service planning, order processing, and service execution within the Electrification business area. Together with your team, you will ensure comprehensive customer support for Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems across the German-speaking region of Switzerland.


Reporting directly to the Head of Service UPS Systems, you will make a significant contribution to the implementation of the service strategy and the promotion of business growth. Through efficient planning and targeted allocation of resources, while ensuring compliance with established processes, procedures, and guidelines, you will drive high service quality and operational excellence.


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Leading, coaching, and developing a regional service team consisting of Service Coordinators, Order Handling Specialists, Technical Support Engineers, and Field Service Technicians, while fostering a motivating, safe, and performance-oriented work environment.
  • Taking overall responsibility for all service activities, customer orders, and maintenance operations within the region, ensuring the achievement of quality, performance, and commercial targets, maintaining customer relationships, and delivering high levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Providing operational support to the team (approximately 60% of the role) in service planning (FSL), including the review and approval of weekly reports and expense claims.
  • Ensuring the implementation of and compliance with all occupational health and safety requirements.


Your • Qualifications

  • Technical vocational training in Electrical Engineering, complemented by a job-related advanced qualification at Higher Technical College level (e.g., Certified Technician, Master Craftsman, or equivalent).
  • Strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience in the maintenance, servicing, commissioning, and repair of electrical installations.
  • Experience with power electronics and/or UPS systems.
  • Several years of leadership experience in a similar position.
  • A flexible and resilient personality with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • A structured and solution-oriented approach to work and problem-solving.
  • Willingness to travel throughout Switzerland.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications as well as SAP or other ERP systems.
  • Excellent German and English language skills, both written and spoken; French and Italian are an advantage.


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:


  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credits
  • Exclusive employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)
  • Parental leave
  • Contribution towards fitness and health programs
  • Eco Bonus (sustainability incentive)


More About Us

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Department Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a Research Scientist, you will be working on sensing solutions for ABB’s next generation systems and products. We are looking for a team member with a proven research track record and the eagerness to transfer and apply world class academic research into an industrial environment. You will work within the highly motivated, international team of scientists at ABB Research. • We offer an open and innovative work environment with many diverse opportunities to grow your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contributing to and leading research projects in the field of sensors and industrial sensing applications addressing the needs of our businesses, with applications including automation, process industries, and electrification.
  • Together with multidisciplinary project teams, develop novel, high-value sensing products and solutions from the concept definition phase to the experimental verification.
  • Evaluate new technologies and conduct technical surveys, generate project proposals with business impact and collaborate with researchers and engineers from other research centers, ABB business units, as well as from universities.
  • Disseminate your results with scientific publications and internal technical reports, generate intellectual property.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD university degree in electrical engineering, computer science, or related field
  • Theoretical and practical knowledge in signal processing and data analytics (including ML/deep-learning-based) e.g. denoising, feature extraction, time-series analysis and anomaly detection, signal classification and pattern recognition
  • Hands-on experience with test, design, simulation and validation of electronic systems, embedded electronics, (wireless-) connectivity, testing methodologies and data-driven validation, edge/embedded ML deployment
  • Solid experience of getting ideas from concepts to prototypes
  • Strong interest in sensing technologies and integration of sensors in systems. Context knowledge in electrification-related applications considered as a plus
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages (C/C++, Python, Matlab and modern ML frameworks -PyTorch-), and use of coding agents
  • Excellent communication skills and team player attitude and excellent command (written & oral) of the English language

More about us

The ABB Research Center located in Baden-Dättwil, Switzerland, is where we investigate new technologies which support and drive the development of ABB’s next-generation products and solutions. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application, including CV, cover letter and list of publications. If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com. This position is managed by Pedro Labian (Talent Acquisition Partner at ABB Switzerland).
